items.title: TotalEnergies to transfer Papua LNG operatorship to ExxonMobil
items.summary: TotalEnergies will sell a 9.1% interest, calculated after the back-in of Kumul Petroleum, to its Papua LNG partners.

items.title: TotalEnergies Cuts Papua LNG Cost to $14 Billion, Exxon to Become Operator
items.summary: Papua LNG moves closer to a final investment decision after major cost, ownership and commercial changes.

items.title: Santos Boosts Papua LNG Stake as ExxonMobil Takes Operatorship
items.summary: Santos is increasing its exposure to the Papua LNG project in a $189 million deal as ExxonMobil prepares to take control of operations.

items.title: Oil Majors Seek Bigger Bargaining Power in Labor Disputes
items.summary: Big Oil is taking a tougher stance in labor negotiations, with BP and Marathon using refinery lockouts to push for concessions from unionized workers.

items.title: Chevron Stayed in Venezuela for 20 Years While Rivals Left. Here's Why Its CEO Says Patience Pays Off.
items.summary: Chevron's patience is paying big dividends.

items.title: Why I Just Added to My Chevron Position Despite Trump Criticism
items.summary: Speculation that Chevron is about to close two major oil-field deals in Venezuela "trumps" White House knocks on the company.

items.title: Exxon Falls While Diesel Margins Explode to $108
items.summary: Record diesel economics favor Exxon's refining arm, but the stock still followed crude lower.

items.title: Can ExxonMobil Benefit From the Current Energy Market Tightness?
items.summary: XOM gain from higher oil prices and tighter refining capacity as Guyana and Permian growth strengthen its near-term profit setup.
